headline: Hinduja Global Solutions Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - We have to inform you that the Board of Directors of IndusInd Media & Communications Limited ( IMCL ), a subsidiary of the Hinduja Global Solutions Limited has approved the divest/ sell of it s (i.e. IMCL) entire…
detail: General Updates - We have to inform you that the Board of Directors of IndusInd Media & Communications Limited ( IMCL ), a subsidiary of the Hinduja Global Solutions Limited has approved the divest/ sell of it s (i.e. IMCL) entire shareholding in Bhima Riddhi Infotainment Private Limited and Vinsat Digital Private Limited. Detailed disclosure in this regard is attached please.
